name: 88030 · Deming, NM
findings: ZIP 88030 (Deming) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88030 (Deming) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 88030 (Deming) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
